cookies.message: We use cookies to ensure you get the best experience on our website. By continuing to use our site, you agree to our use of cookies.
cookies.preferencesDesc: Manage your cookie settings. You can enable or disable different types of cookies below.
cookies.essentialDesc: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off.
cookies.analyticsDesc: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site.
cookies.marketingDesc: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners.

policyContent.whatText: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to the owners of the site.
policyContent.howText: We use cookies to understand how you interact with our website, to keep you signed in, and to save your preferences.
policyContent.typesEssential: Essential Cookies: Necessary for the website to function properly. You cannot opt-out of these.
policyContent.typesAnalytics: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with the website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
policyContent.typesMarketing: Marketing Cookies: Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant ads.
policyContent.managingText: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clicking on the "Preferences" button in our cookie banner or settings.

privacyContent.collectText: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, and financial data you choose to input.
privacyContent.useText: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, such as to process your transactions, generate reports, and send you related information.
privacyContent.securityText: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and destruction. Your financial data is yours and we do not access it for any purpose other than providing the service.
privacyContent.lgpdText: We are fully compliant with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD). You have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your personal data.
